parsed.why: New 2025 criminalisation of same-sex conduct with deportation of foreigners stated as consequence; no enforcement record yet, but a visitor with a partner read as same-sex faces statutory, discretionary exposure and no trans-specific recourse.

Decriminalised, but an immigration bar on homosexual non-citizens (unenforced), no hate-crime category, no trans recognition, and documented dating-app ambush robberies with police warnings. Violence is recurring and unremedied.

Strong legal framework and notary-based marker change, but armed-group kill lists and dozens of trans women killed yearly, with a state-linked war-crimes backdrop. No background homicide rate, so the violence rate cannot be benchmarked.

No criminalisation, but gender-change is barred, so documents cannot be aligned. Documented identity-check harassment and arbitrary arrests of trans people, with violent detentions. Most recent dated violence is 2020.

Constitutional protection, 2024 hate-crimes law covering gender identity, and a 2025 court order requiring correctional care. Exposure remains through mismatched-document humiliation, contested facility access, and township violence against trans women.
